_comment: Aliases from non-SPDX <license> strings found in ROS 2 Jazzy package.xml files to SPDX license expressions. Match on the tag text with surrounding whitespace stripped.

Apache License 2.0.note: Spelling variant of the Apache License 2.0.

Apache 2.0.note: Spelling variant of the Apache License 2.0.

Apache License, Version 2.0.note: Spelling variant of the Apache License 2.0.

Apache 2.note: Spelling variant of the Apache License 2.0.

Apache2.note: Spelling variant of the Apache License 2.0.

Apache-2.note: Spelling variant of the Apache License 2.0.

Apache 2.0 License.note: Spelling variant of the Apache License 2.0.

Apache License Version 2.0.note: Spelling variant of the Apache License 2.0.

apache 2.0.note: Spelling variant of the Apache License 2.0.

Apache Licence 2.0.note: Spelling variant of the Apache License 2.0.

Apache license 2.0.note: Spelling variant of the Apache License 2.0.

BSD.note: Unversioned "BSD". In ROS this conventionally means the 3-clause license: 540 of the 567 packages with a license file nearby have BSD-3-Clause text (alone or next to another license), 9 have only BSD-2-Clause; 67 have no license file.

BSD License 2.0.note: "BSD License 2.0" is an old name for the revised (3-clause) BSD license; the one package using it (teleop_twist_keyboard) ships BSD-3-Clause text.

Eclipse Distribution License 1.0.note: SPDX has no EDL identifier; the Eclipse Distribution License 1.0 is the BSD-3-Clause text and SPDX directs it to BSD-3-Clause.

GPLv3.note: GPL version 3 with no "or later" stated. Taken literally this is -only; source headers in some packages (control_box_rst, hector_rviz_overlay) say "or any later version", so those packages should probably declare GPL-3.0-or-later upstream.

GPL-3.0.note: Deprecated SPDX id; SPDX defines it as identical to GPL-3.0-only.

GPLv2.note: GPL version 2 with no "or later" stated; taken literally as -only. Headers in octovis and popf mostly say "or later".

GPL-2.note: GPL version 2 with no "or later" stated; taken literally as -only.

GNU General Public License v2.0.note: GPL version 2 with no "or later" stated; taken literally as -only.

GPL-2.0.note: Deprecated SPDX id; SPDX defines it as identical to GPL-2.0-only.

LGPLv3.note: LGPL version 3 with no "or later" stated; taken literally as -only.

LGPL-v3.note: LGPL version 3 with no "or later" stated; taken literally as -only.

GNU Lesser General Public License v3.0 (.note: LGPL version 3 with no "or later" stated; taken literally as -only.

LGPL-3.0.note: Deprecated SPDX id; SPDX defines it as identical to LGPL-3.0-only.

LGPLv2.1.note: LGPL version 2.1 with no "or later" stated; taken literally as -only.

LGPL v2.1.note: LGPL version 2.1 with no "or later" stated; taken literally as -only.

GNU Lesser Public License 2.1.note: LGPL version 2.1 with no "or later" stated; taken literally as -only.

AGPLv3.note: AGPL version 3 with no "or later" stated; taken literally as -only.

GPL.note: No version given. The GPL lets the recipient pick any published version when none is specified, so the literal SPDX mapping is GPL-1.0-or-later. The three packages actually ship GPL-3 (imu_transformer), GPL-2 (wiimote) and nothing (imu_pipeline); they should be fixed upstream.

LGPL.note: No version given; literal mapping is LGPL-2.0-or-later (the earliest LGPL). The five packages actually ship LGPL-3 (ros_canopen, libphidget22), LGPL-2.1 (slam_toolbox, qpoases upstream) and nothing (lms1xx); they should be fixed upstream.

BSD, LGPL.note: Two licenses in one tag. Only used by the phidgets_drivers metapackage, whose repo ships BSD-3-Clause and LGPL-3 license files. Written as an SPDX expression.

Public Domain.note: SPDX has no identifier for public domain dedications; a LicenseRef- id is the SPDX-sanctioned way to name it.

Universal Robots A/S’ Terms and Conditio.note: Proprietary Universal Robots terms with no SPDX id; a LicenseRef- id names it.

MyLicense.note: Template placeholder (smacc2 performance test package). Nothing to map; should be fixed upstream.
